_note: Country-specific layer override defaults for India. Loaded at runtime by LayerManager. All fields can be overridden by the developer via the layers.overrides config option.

osmFilter._note: Hides India's own borders (adm0 IND) and Bhutan's (adm0 BTN — Bhutan is an Indian protectorate, drawn from our custom data), disputed lines, sub-national lines, and the PAK–CHN Karakoram pair (entirely claimed by India), inside the bbox. Neighbour-vs-neighbour international borders (Nepal–China, Afghanistan–Pakistan, China–Myanmar) stay visible.
